pairwise_winding — DRIVE braidpath op

• Data kinds: any → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.pairwise_winding(trajectories, obstacles=None) (to call the implementation directly, import braidpath; braidpath.pairwise_winding(trajectories, obstacles=None); from the registry, opsdrive.get("pairwise_winding"))

Usage

Relative winding number for each pair of strands [turns] (total change of the argument of the relative vector / 2π). Symmetric matrix, zero diagonal.

The increment of the argument is taken as atan2(cross, dot) (principal value (−π, π]). If a single step turns half a revolution or more, the direction is undetermined, so it stops. Closed form: for a pure braid, with c the signed number of crossings between the two strands, 2π·W = π c exactly (gate). The winding number is a commutative invariant, so it cannot distinguish braids of the commutator form [A, B] (winding number 0 for every pair, yet nontrivial) —— which is why braids are used.

Returns: (n, n) float array (n = agents + obstacle points).

Raises: ValueError (two strands reach the same point, a single-step increment reaches π —— use finer steps).
